The racing kit is an explicitly declared interpretation of period motorsport preparation, not a claim that the stock photo shows a race car: Fotografia originale del modello stradale · Audi Coupè S2. STRICT hand-drawn 1990s PC racing game pixel art on a logical320x128 grid: sharp stepped outline, dark one-pixel panel gaps, clean square clusters and compact5-6shade material ramps.
